'''Moriden''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He tasked an Imperial [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to steal a prototype stealth [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]].
